notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only text read is the name 'JUNCTION' in the British Columbia index, with no detail page or description in the text read. Two web searches and the cached pages found nothing more about this lookout. The story is about 25 words, well under the 120-word norm, because no source gives more; it is left short rather than padded. The record's district (Cariboo Regional District), coordinates (52.58907, -120.92289) and BC base map symbol 9095 come from the TRIM point layer in data/raw/bc_geowarehouse, not from any text read, so the story leaves the district out. Do not confuse with Junction Mountain in Alberta (Kananaskis, Bow River Forest Reserve), which appears on the Alberta index. A human could try the BC Archives or a BC Forest Service history before the entry is extended.
